summary: Defines the payto URI scheme for designating payment targets. A single scheme for all kinds of payment targets lets applications offer user interactions for payment links and makes it easier to add new payment systems. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Just as a web link points to a page, a payto link points to a place you can send money to. This document defines how to write such a link, whatever payment system is behind it.

questions: how to write a payment link uri
